function.name: network_summary
function.description: Transaction count, accepted value, decline rate, flagged merchants and open incidents for a period, optionally for one channel or merchant.

period.description: Time window relative to the data date. Default this_week (last 7 days).

channel.description: ecommerce = E-commerce CIB/Edahabia, pos = TPE/POS terminal, mobile = Mobile App, nfc = Contactless/NFC, transfer = Bank transfer/virement.

function.name: explain_merchant
function.description: Why a merchant was flagged: its latest anomaly with observed vs expected values, evidence and the suggested check.

function.name: merchant_health
function.description: Health components of one merchant over the last 7 days.

function.name: open_incidents
function.description: Unresolved incidents ranked by priority, with severity, state, owner and estimated exposure.

function.name: forecast
function.description: Advisory 7-day transaction forecast with 80% interval and backtest error, network-wide or for one merchant.

function.name: channel_activity
function.description: Concurrent abnormal behaviour per payment channel (network advisories, outages, decline waves) and channel volumes.

period.description: Time window relative to the data date. Default this_week (last 7 days).

channel.description: ecommerce = E-commerce CIB/Edahabia, pos = TPE/POS terminal, mobile = Mobile App, nfc = Contactless/NFC, transfer = Bank transfer/virement.

function.name: top_declines
function.description: Merchants with the most declined transactions above their expected rate.

period.description: Time window relative to the data date. Default this_week (last 7 days).

function.name: activity_shortfall
function.description: Merchants furthest below their expected transaction count (activity drops).

period.description: Time window relative to the data date. Default this_week (last 7 days).

function.name: next_checks
function.description: Who acts and what to check first for open incidents.
